messages:
Mia (SEO): Quick note — building a compact launch SEO playbook for the webinar + three launch posts. Need a one-page ops checklist covering: canonical slug policy, param striplist, redirect source file, UTM naming, schema snippets, and internal-link anchor guidance. Keep it minimal for launch ops.
Nora - Content: Ill annotate each draft with primary keyword + two supporting keywords, exact CTA targets, and suggested anchor text. Will put examples in #marketing-drafts.
Sam P: Redirects: put explicit mappings in marketing/seo/redirects.yaml. 301 only. I'll add entries for legacy slugs, trailing-slash patterns, and a few test regexes for known redirects.
Aj: Canonical policy: canonicalize to short kebab-case slug, drop date prefixes, prefer no trailing slash for posts. Add rel=canonical link tags and server Link header for safety.
Kevin (Dev): We'll implement small middleware to: strip ad/session params (fbclid, gclid, _gl, amp, utm_test), set Link rel=canonical header, and serve 301s based on the YAML mapping. Where should I put smoke tests?
Mia (SEO): Add smoke tests to the marketing repo CI; test a sample legacy -> canonical 301 + assert Link header present and canonical URL in page head.
Aj: Internal links: follow pillar->post->webinar flow. Use descriptive anchors (avoid "learn more"). Add data-seo-anchor attribute to top funnel anchors for quick tracking. Limit duplicate anchors per page.
Nora - Content: For schema, add Article schema on benchmark post, Event/Webinar schema on landing, BreadcrumbList on both, and FAQPage with 2-3 Qs on the landing (include Qs in the draft).
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: prelaunch crawl 48h after redirects merge.
Mia (SEO): UTM convention: utm_source=redwood, utm_medium=content, utm_campaign={launch|webinar|benchmark}_v1. For webinars add utm_content=hero|footer as needed.
Sam P: I'll open PR for redirects + tests by Mon AM. Kevin, ping me when middleware is ready so I can run the smoke tests.
Kevin (Dev): ETA middleware + tests Tue AM. Will add docs to marketing/README.md about the redirects.yaml and striplist.
Mia (SEO): Final ask: Ill draft the one-page QA checklist and post to the launch playbook. Can everyone confirm their bits by EOD Friday?
